title: Business Systems Analyst II
description: The Opportunity: Contributes to the implementation of new data management processes, standards, and operational plans, ensuring improvements in data accuracy, security, and governance. Supports master data management efforts related to product, customer, and regulatory data to maintain consistency across business functions. Manages smaller data-related projects and/or processes, such as data validation initiatives and system upgrades or modifications that impact master data records. Assists in the implementation of new data governance standards and compliance initiatives and ensures proper execution of established data governance protocols. Problems and issues are typically recurring but varied, requiring the analysis of multiple factors such as data inconsistencies, integration challenges, or evolving business requirements. Applies expertise in evaluating root causes, selecting known solutions, and optimizing data workflows. Engages with IT teams, compliance officers and external vendors to ensure data integrity, clarify requirements, and support operational alignment. Avantor is looking for a Business Systems Analyst II to join our team! What we’re looking for Education: Bachelor’s degree and/or equivalent experience, education and training Experience: 3+ years of experience supporting ERP or enterprise business systems. oExperience working with complex organizational structures, including hierarchical, functional, and matrix environments. oAbility to partner with business stakeholders to identify needs, recommend solutions, and drive process improvements. oExposure supporting ERP or enterprise systems such as Epicor, SAP, Workday, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, or Exact. oAbility to gather business requirements, troubleshoot system issues, and support system enhancements. oProven ability to manage assigned tasks, follow through on priorities, and escalate risks or blockers appropriately. Preferred Qualifications : Experience supporting system testing, validation, user acceptance testing, documentation, or data review activities. Experience creating training materials, quick reference guides, process documentation, or business communications. Ability to effectively influence and collaborate with stakeholders across multiple levels of the organization. Curiosity, ownership, and willingness to learn ERP processes and business system best practices. How you will thrive and create an impac t The Business Systems Analyst II helps cross-functional teams to drive system optimization, process improvements, and data-driven decision making across the Avantor Fluid Handling organization. This role contributes to issue resolution, enhancement intake, documentation, testing, reporting support, training, and adoption activities while embodying Avantor's iCARE values. Key Responsibilities Support day-to-day Epicor ERP and enterprise system needs by helping users document issues, clarify requirements, and identify next steps. Analyze business requirements and translate them into Epicor ERP configurations, reporting solutions, process improvements, and system enhancements. Facilitate cross-functional discussions to evaluate business needs, recommend best practices, and prioritize enhancement opportunities. Support testing, validation, deployment, and change management activities for system upgrades, enhancements, and process improvements. Utilize ABS methodologies and continuous improvement principles to optimize business processes and system performance. Develop and deliver training materials, user documentation, and end-user learning programs through online learning platforms, Viva Engage, and other communication channels. Support ERP-related projects, serving as a project resource as needed. Partner closely with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), business leaders, and technical teams to align system capabilities with organizational objectives. Monitor system performance to support business growth. KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND ABILITIES Proven ability to translate business requirements into scalable ERP solutions while supporting system configuration, data integration, security, and continuous process optimization. Strong background in ERP implementations, business process improvement, end user training, multi company and multi-site environments, and operational process optimization. Proven success leading ERP rollouts, supporting acquisitions, gathering business requirements, developing documentation, and driving adoption of best practices across manufacturing, supply chain, and business operations. Experienced partnering with technical and functional teams to improve processes, support users, and enhance overall ERP effectiveness. Experience supporting ERP projects, troubleshooting technical issues, optimizing business processes, and integrating solutions such as warehouse management systems, shop floor automation, manufacturing execution systems and AI agentic solutions. title: Sr. Business Analyst - Global Customer Reporting
description: The Opportunity: Under limited supervision, responsible for generating metrics and other reports to the business on time with accuracy in data. Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems. Filter and clean data, and review computer reports, printouts, and performance indicators to locate and correct code problems. Identify trends or patterns in data sets. POSITION PROFILE: (Basic Purpose of Position) Job Summary Overview The Opportunity: As a Senior Business Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in leading process transitions, driving transformational initiatives, and delivering impactful training programs. Leveraging your expertise, you will support data-driven decision-making within the team and act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders. You will collaborate closely with team leaders and managers to identify opportunities for continuous improvement, enhancing processes, efficiency, and overall business outcomes. Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Analytics, Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science,) Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in advanced excel reporting, Qlik, Power BI, Power Apps, and process improvements or worked as Reporting Analyst for a minimum of 2 years. Major Role and Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain customized reports, dashboards, and data models to deliver accurate, actionable, and timely insights to stakeholders. Leverage tools such as Excel macros, Power Apps, Power Automate, and BI platforms to automate data extraction, transformation, and reporting processes, improving efficiency and accuracy. Create intuitive and visually compelling dashboards and visualizations using tools like Power BI, Tableau, and Excel to effectively communicate insights. Ensure robust data governance by implementing best practices for data accuracy, integrity, and consistency through validation, quality checks, and issue resolution. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including business stakeholders, data engineers, and IT—to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights. Drive process optimization by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance reporting efficiency. Develop and maintain documentation, user guides, and training materials, and conduct enablement sessions to promote effective use of reporting tools and self-service analytics. Perform trend analysis and forecasting to support business planning, uncovering patterns, risks, and opportunities from historical data Mentor and coach Analysts and Specialists, providing guidance to enhance team capabilities and performance. Participate actively in data governance initiatives to ensure adherence to data standards and best practices. Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in reporting and analytics to drive continuous improvement and innovation. QUALIFICATIONS (Education/Training, Experience and Certifications) Proficiency in data analysis, visualization, and reporting tools such as Excel and Power BI. Strong process orientation, sound judgment, and the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across projects and functions. Ability to manage multiple priorities independently, demonstrating strong ownership and a proactive mindset. Focus on driving efficiency and continuous improvement in all areas of work. Advanced analytical skills with the ability to gather, structure, analyze, and interpret large volumes of data. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex insights for diverse audiences. Proven ability to independently manage projects and deliver process improvements with minimal supervision. High level of integrity, with a collaborative approach to working in cross-functional team environments. Strong attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and reliability in data analysis and reporting.
